probe.dns_deviation: Docker registers a container's compose service name on every network it joins and gives no way to unregister it, so the names below resolve in addition to the aliases. Each is pinned to an address that is already one of this stack's own services; a name resolving anywhere else fails this property. Removing them needs a resolver of our own in front of 127.0.0.11 - see gateway/docker/NATIVE_STACK.md.
